supportModel.broaderMeaning: Total traceable analytical reach, including governed secondary, conceptual, future-extension, or derived support.
supportModel.interpretation: Corpus support reflects recurrence and breadth within this practitioner discourse corpus. It does not indicate scientific validity, consensus, importance, prevalence, or real-world effect size.
supportModel.primaryMeaning: Direct, governed evidence breadth with explicit item, content-unit, cluster, family, category, and concentration measures.
